input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1), Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance (whichever is later) and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2), plus no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3). The remedy is real and tiered — re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure — and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4). The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or other remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Acceptance in Section 6 reinforces this with a rejection/correction and refund path. No redline required.
